operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Adds a payment method to the account. This is a v2 native-entity endpoint served from the `/v2/api/entity` base and authenticated with a Bearer token.

The body is a flat JSON object. **No field is strictly required** by the server, but you should provide `payment_gateway` — it is the method's business key and is **unique within the account** (creating a second method with the same `payment_gateway` fails). `id` is assigned by the server and must not be sent; `created`/`modified`, `site_id`, `category`, and `credentials` are managed by the server and are not accepted from the request.

On success the endpoint returns the new record id.

payment_gateway.description: Gateway key/identifier for the payment method. Unique within the account; creating a duplicate fails with a 400.

default.description:
Whether this is the account's default payment method. Defaults to `0`.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Not the default |
| 1 | Default |

active.description:
Whether the payment method is enabled. Defaults to `0`.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Disabled |
| 1 | Enabled |

manually_added.description:
Whether the method was added manually. Defaults to `0`.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | No |
| 1 | Yes |

disable_for_client.description:
Whether the method is hidden from the client portal. Defaults to `0`.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Visible |
| 1 | Hidden |

treasury_id.description: Id of a treasury to link this payment method to.

branch_id.description: Id of the branch this method belongs to. Defaults to `1` when omitted.

id.description: Id of the newly created payment method.

400.description: The payment method could not be saved. The most common cause is a duplicate `payment_gateway` (which is unique within the account).

e.description: Underlying error detail. For a database-constraint failure this is an object with `errorInfo`, `connectionName`, and `readWriteType`.

error.description: Error detail string (a database error message for constraint failures).

401.description: Authentication or authorization failed. A missing, invalid, or expired Bearer token returns a plain `401` (no JSON body). An authenticated caller who lacks permission receives a JSON `{ "error": "…" }`.
